title: A Corporate car's impact bark on Parkland A3: three sentences, 120 characters, raw figures
request: Write the Corporate (tier 02) car's impact bark for Parkland A3 (The belvedere) as three full sentences of about 120 characters in all. Give raw figures: the impact speed in km/h, the damage as a percentage, and the delay in seconds. Start the line with the car's tag and a colon, like 'V02:'. Put each sentence on its own line.
